dem_viewshed — DEM visibility op

• 数据种类:depth → image2d

• 调用:import demops; demops.dem_viewshed(dem, cell_size, observer_rc, observer_height_m=1.7, target_height_m=0.0, max_distance_m=None)(或 opsdem.get("dem_viewshed"))
